summary: Tested onboarding Phase 1 (projects) + Phase 2 (Import Centre) backend and frontend. All 15 backend pytest tests passed (customer-types/9, progressive-disclosure checklist for multi_site+crm+memberships, list/get/patch/checklist-step, go-live gating then success, dashboard, duplicate-org 409 guard, import types/template, auto-map of aliases Email Address/First Name/Surname/Telephone/Company, validate flags invalid email & in-file duplicate, commit skip then re-skip existing, commit update, saved mappings POST+GET). Frontend smoke verified all key data-testids present after login: onboarding-projects, onb-stat-active, onb-new-project-btn, onb-create-dialog, onb-create-submit, onboarding-subtab-imports, import-wizard, iw-type, iw-org, iw-upload-btn. Imports subtab renders Core records (quick CSV) section underneath as required. Test records cleaned up (projects archived, contacts deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding_import.py:_existing_dupe_keys does per-key full-collection scans to_list(20000) — acceptable for current volumes but should switch to indexed case-insensitive $in for larger orgs.
iw-template testid only appears after import_type is chosen (conditional render) — fine, but main agent may want to expose the template button when type is preset to make discovery easier.
_validate_doc accepts any string for joined_at (kind='date') without parsing — consider ISO date validation.
onboarding_projects.archive_project always returns ok=true even on already-archived; idempotent which is good.
seed_data_creation: Created two test onboarding projects (prefixed TESTONB...) plus test CRM contacts (test_testonb*@example.com); cleaned up in test_zzz_cleanup. Some imported contacts may persist if CRM delete endpoint signature differs — emails are tagged with TESTONB for easy DB removal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 1 + Phase 2 fully verified at /api/onboarding/* (projects, customer-types, checklist, go-live, dashboard, import/types, import/template/<t>, import/analyze, import/validate, import/commit, import/mappings). Frontend testids per spec are all wired correctly under Master Admin → Organisations → Onboarding (?section=onboarding). iw-template only shows after iw-type is chosen.
